name: Fit for a Princess
summary: Tessa Dawnbright needs warm coyote pelts for her daughter Emma’s bassinet in Farholde Keep. She hopes softer bedding will help the baby sleep and bring quiet to Farholde.

sections.title: A Mother's Request
sections.body: Tessa rocks Emma in Farholde Keep, hoping to settle her crying daughter. Her husband made a bassinet, but Tessa worries its blankets are too old. She asks you to bring coyote pelts to line Emma’s bed, hoping the warmer bedding will soothe her.

sections.title: A Welcome Return
sections.body: Tessa greets you when you return with the pelts. She finds them warm and soft, and says they are for Emma. Tessa looks tired as she cares for her baby.

faq.answer: Tessa Dawnbright is Emma’s mother in Farholde Keep.

faq.q: Why does Tessa need coyote pelts?
faq.answer: Tessa wants to line Emma’s bassinet with warm, soft pelts because she worries the blankets are too old.
Emma is crying, and Tessa is trying to help her sleep.

attribution: In-game quest text: Fit for a Princess
